name: NEURA 4NE1 Mini Standard
summary: A 1.32 m, 36 kg compact German humanoid for education, voice interaction and demonstrations, without hands; reservation only.

germany.statusNote: Made in Germany. Refundable 100 EUR reservation on the NEURA site; the maker expects availability in 2026 (datasheet said spring 2026). No deliveries confirmed.

priceEur.note: Estimated price, excluding taxes and shipping.

sellers.name: NEURA Robotics GmbH
sellers.note: Manufacturer in Metzingen, Germany. Online reservation for single units; commercial quantities through the contact form.

specs.label: Degrees of freedom
specs.conditions: Base unit only, without hands or end effectors

specs.label: Payload
specs.conditions: As stated on the datasheet; not specified per arm

specs.label: Interfaces
specs.value: Wi-Fi 6, Gigabit Ethernet, ROS 2, C++ and Python SDK, NeuraSync

notes: Manipulation is "not included" in the Standard version; the Pro version adds 12-DoF dexterous hands.
Maker says it works on ground level and uneven surfaces; stair walking is still under development.
Use cases named by the maker: education, basic voice interaction, entertainment.

images.alt: NEURA 4NE1 Mini in a showroom, shown with five-finger hands (hands come only with the Pro version)

evidence.task: Shown in live demonstrations at Automate 2026

sources.title: Reserve 4NE1 Mini (Standard and Pro, prices, availability)
